title: [Complet's] Yagai Gakushuu 2 / 野外学習2 [English Patched]
description:
![Image](http://www.complets.co.jp/complet%27s/yagai2/yg2_hp_02.JPG)

Translation Team: TheOneWhoWatches, BoredTranslator, Emmaus

Released: 2012-03-30
English Patch: v.1.1.3 - Jul 29, 2022 

 - Change system locale to Japanese.

INSTRUCTIONS FOR BUGGED SCENES:

Bug #1 is scene file D3A_H/D3A_H2. It will appear if you select this set of choices:

Pick any scene until the menu with the options: Beach, Cliffs, Promenade 2, Promenade 3
Pick any of the scenes EXCEPT for the Beach
Pick Bungalow
Pick Promenade 3


Bug #2 is scene file D3PB_G. It will appear if you select this set of choices:

Pick any scene until the menu with the options: Beach, Cliffs, Promenade 2, Promenade 3
Pick any of the scenes EXCEPT for the Beach
Pick Bungalow
Pick Cliffs
Pick Asami and Yuu
Pick Go
Pick Forest 1

Both scenes can be accessed through replacing the MPX folder with the original game files (located in "Original MPX"). Once the bugged choice has been selected,
save and reapply the files from the MPX folder located in the patch. You should now be able to access the scene in English from your previous save.

Description:

"Will you tutor meeee?"
There is a program described as “Male and Female Practical Education”, it all started with a single classroom and eventually spread to others. This summer break Arita Atsushi was enrolled in this program. He's afraid he won't talk to any of his classmates because he gets nervous talking to others, especially girls. He doesn't know anything about this camp other than it's being held on a remote island, and he's really hoping the experience changes him for the better.
